Every token sink is hardcoded: VY->VYT (burn), withdrawn asset->this->UniV3->USDC->Balancer (repay), leftover USDC->UniV2->VY->buybackOfficer (VBBO, admin-set address, NOT caller). audit.goldenRule: TEXTBOOK CORRECT (cap-DECREASE sink). Burn vyAmount VY -> VYT == vco.decreaseAssetCap(asset, vyAmount) (exact same amount). withdrawAmount = vyAmount*reserve/cap => new_reserve/new_cap == reserve/cap EXACTLY (backing ratio preserved; integer floor over-backs by dust, never under-backs). DOUBLE-GUARDED: VFO pre-checks vyAmount<=headroom (cap-effectiveFloor) AND VCO.decreaseAssetCap independently reverts if newCap < effectiveFloor. Caller-independent: a bad flashAmount only reverts (atomic flash repay is the self-protection); a caller cannot make the protocol release collateral disproportionate to VY burned, nor under-back, nor redirect funds.
audit.permissionlessSafety: The permissionless redesign is SAFE: (1) profit -> BBO not caller; (2) bad sizing / VY>=floor -> revert (flash repay fails or NoHeadroom); (3) sandwich on the minOut=0 V2/V3 swaps harms only the CALLER (gas/revert) or reduces BBO profit — never under-backs the protocol (collateral release scales with VY burned); (4) receiveFlashLoan gated by msg.sender==vault + transient _IN_FLASH_LOAN_SLOT guard (no spoof/reentry); (5) reward farming bounded by floor-defense opportunity (VY must be below floor) + VGO per-call cap (0.005 ETH) + VGC epoch ceiling.
